acceptable_paraphrases: there are 12 lines in a hexahedron
the corners amount to 6 on a cuboid
critical_errors: incorrect number of faces, edges or vertices
mixing up the terms face, edge and vertex
misconceptions: a cube has more than 6 vertices
there are fewer than 12 edges in a cube
the number of faces is equal to the number of edges
grading_notes: Points should be awarded for each correct term provided, with specific keywords emphasized. Mislabeling parts of a cube (e.g., calling an edge a face) will result in critical errors.
